Residual (3) direction · 2026-11-12T21:55Z (the epic seat's call, relayed by this seat):
- Chosen: C. The exact read adopts the registry's binding only over the holders it counts itself (the served set). (1) and (2) move as the card says; (3) keeps #32183 R4-A, recorded as the same ruled shape as its row 33.
- Why: R4-A and the #32497 default (only served holders count, except the two permission-set reads) are the current rulings. With Y disabled, X is the one served holder and serves the row by the D4 one-holder rule, with no widening and no pick. A would split the answer between two rows of the same shape; B would reverse #32815's second round and move the registry binding.
- If the disabled-state count is ever unified, that is a family card covering package-less rows as well, not this card.
- Out of scope: the ignored pair override on the bare member read is #32849 (p2, queued, after #32561 and #32606). The envelope stamped Z at `?package=A.custom` is re-measured on #32808's head before any card is filed.
- No PR before #32815 merges.
